t: Sargent - MFA Prints
John Singer Sargent | Items for sale, auction results & history
s: John Singer Sargent paintings are celebrated for their exquisite detail, lifelike quality and the ability to capture the personality and essence of his subjects. His mastery of light and texture brought a dynamic quality to his work, setting him apart from his contemporaries. One of his most famous works is Madame X (1884, The Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York), which depicts Madame Pierre Gautreau, a Parisian socialite.
